title: JSON 序列化选项：ensure_ascii / 缩进 / 分隔符
code:
import json

obj = {"b": 1, "a": [1, 2], "cn": "中"}

print("默认            :", json.dumps(obj))
print("ensure_ascii=F  :", json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False))
print("sort_keys=T     :", json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True))
print("紧凑分隔符      :", json.dumps(obj, separators=(",", ":")))
print()

print("indent=2 可读版:")
print(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
print()

print("往返后中文仍是  :", json.loads(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False))["cn"])
print("默认写法的字节数 =", len(json.dumps(obj).encode("utf-8")))
print("不转义的字节数   =", len(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")))
print()
print("要点: ensure_ascii 只影响字节占用与可读性，不影响往返正确性")
